weapon.d: After combat, if unit attacked, converts bonuses on foe into penalties through its next action.
After combat, if unit attacked, converts bonuses on target and foes within 2 spaces of target into penalties through their next actions.

assist.d: Restores 8 HP to target ally. Range = 2.
Restores HP = 50% of Atk. (Minimum of 8 HP.) Range = 2.

special.d: When healing an ally with a staff, restores an additional 10 HP to target ally.
If unit's HP > 1 and foe would reduce unit's HP to 0, unit survives with 1 HP.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.

c.d: Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+2 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+3 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+4 during combat."
